summary: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust filed an 8-K on June 5, 2026, disclosing its monthly report for May 2026 (Item 7.01) and announcing a cash distribution of $0.091522 per trust certificate payable on June 10, 2026, to holders of record June 9, 2026 (Item 8.01). The filing is a routine periodic update and distribution announcement with no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return program, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. It is an ordinary issuer update.
